description:
Check the status of one or more orders. Returns status code, delivery date, tracking info, and package details.

IMPORTANT:
- Use the EXACT order ID returned by placeOrder (e.g. "order-1776164561402")
- Newly placed orders need ~30 seconds before Probo processes them — if you get "Order(s) not found", wait and retry
- Test orders (isTest: true) are auto-cancelled and may not appear in status
- Use getAllOrders to find orders by reference or date if you lost the order ID

Statuses: accepted, in_production, shipment_created, shipment_in_transit, shipment_delivered, cancelled.

orderIds.description: Order IDs from placeOrder response, e.g. ["order-1776164561402"]

name: getOrderStatus
